sources.author: Google Street View
sources.observed: Inspected hip terracotta canopy, blue/white fascia, cream columns, blue rounded pump toppers, yellow U guards, hoses and dark trash bins. Old store appearance is not used to replace later storefront.

sources.author: Google Street View
sources.observed: Inspected 3873 S Las Vegas Blvd canopy and pump blue toppers/yellow guards. Gravel island, price cabinet and palms visible; store entrance partly obscured. Preserve inferred existing pump positions; do not absorb street bollards or adjacent billboard.

sources.author: Google Street View
sources.observed: Inspected Psychic Sessions 3953 facade: dentils, white cream stucco, two doors/windows, projecting marquee, parapet eye sign, small red WE ARE OPEN sign, number 3953. Large white wheeled sign on forecourt with red borders/text and black base. Chipped paint and boarded panel remain approximate. Neighbor grass/palms outside scope.

limitations: Official interior images show furnishings but do not establish an entire accessible public room layout. Keep incomplete interiors recorded until a supported layout is authored.
Reference images are local research only; never commit or use as game textures.
decisionsForOwner: Use existing mapped footprints and pump placement. Refine pump toppers and protective guards using dated Street View; exact dimensions estimated from pump scale.
A reversible original movable Psychic sign may be added within the forecourt; exact historic position unmeasured. No copied artwork or third-party textures.
Retain no-interior discrepancy: official partial-room pictures do not establish the entrance or full public circulation layout.
